hero.lead: I design, deploy and maintain IT environments that simply work. Focused on security, business continuity and a web experience polished end to end.

about.title: Infrastructure as the invisible base that lets everything run.
about.p1: I'm Ángel Fernández Garriga, systems technician and web developer. I treat technology as a tool at the service of the business: when infrastructure is well thought out, nobody talks about it: it just works.
about.p2: I've run complex hospitality infrastructures: VLAN segmentation, virtualization, multiple servers in parallel and environments that cannot afford a minute of downtime. From there comes my way of working: documentation, standardization and business continuity as pillars.
about.p3: In parallel I design and build professional websites for companies and professionals that want a careful, fast and maintainable online presence, no inflated templates or fine print.

services.title: Two disciplines, one standard.
services.lead: I work with companies and professionals that need a reliable technical base and a careful web presence. Both built to last and grow.

services.s2Lead: Custom professional websites. Fast, maintainable, built to represent you well.
